title: Untitled (Targets and Disc)
description: Framed collage on crumpled white paper integrates concentric target rings, a compact disc, vinyl record fragments, and star motifs across a dense horizontal composition. Yellow ribbon stripes anchor the upper left while scattered perforated dots, photographic fragments, and layered tape elements populate the mid and lower registers.
composition: dense horizontal scatter across white ground
keywords: compact disc and vinyl record collage
